correctness.rationale: For any five-dimensional perfect evolution algebra over any field, invertibility of its structure matrix forces monomial automorphisms and a supported permutation matching. The diagonal kernel embeds in matching-cycle roots with possible orders dividing 1,3,9,7,21,15,31. Separate prime-torsion cases force combined orders at most 155 (31-case exact five-cycle), 60 (5), 126 (7), 36 or 72 (3-primary), and 120 (trivial diagonal). Over C, the weighted five-cycle is normalized by a 31st-root rescaling, attains 31·5=155 and is simple. The normality argument restricts the realized permutation image, not necessarily every graph symmetry. Applies to K-point groups, not group-scheme length.

evidence: Sriwongsa–Zou bound maximal diagonal group as 2^n−1 and classify cycles; Elduque–Labra give the structural exact sequence; Costoya et al restrict selected highly transitive permutation images.
